description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Josh Jones practiced on Saturday.
items.impact: Jones missed time earlier in the Seahawks offseason program. He'll be a full-go heading into training camp.
items.title: Josh Jones practices Saturday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Eric Saubert was able to practice at Seahawks training camp on Saturday.
items.impact: Saubert missed time earlier in the Seahawks offseason program. He'll hold a depth role in the Seahawks tight end room.
items.title: Eric Saubert practices Saturday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: AJ Barner was cleared for training camp.
items.impact: Barner missed time earlier in the offseason after undergoing surgery. He'll be on the TE2 radar for fantasy managers.
items.title: AJ Barner avoids PUP list

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Patriots released OL Sebastian Gutierrez.
items.impact: Gutierrez had two stints on the practice squad last season with New England. He'll figure to seek another opportunity heading into training camp.
items.title: Sebastian Gutierrez released by Patriots

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Patriots claimed rookie WR Kobe Prentice off waivers.
items.impact: Prentice had been waived by the Panthers. The rookie out of Baylor will compete for a depth role in the Patriots wide receiver room.
items.title: Kobe Prentice claimed off waivers by Patriots

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Giants waived DL C.J. Ravenell.
items.impact: Ravenell will figure to seek another opportunity heading into training camp.
items.title: C.J. Ravenell waived by Giants

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Giants waived LB Cam Jones.
items.impact: Jones will figure to seek another opportunity heading into training camp.
items.title: Cam Jones waived by Giants

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Ravens placed CB Bilhal Kone on the PUP list.
items.impact: Kone can be activated at any point during training camp.
items.title: Bilhal Kone (knee) placed on PUP list

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Ravens placed LB Adisa Isaac on the PUP list.
items.impact: Isaac missed all of last season with an elbow injury. He can be activated at any point during training camp.
items.title: Adisa Isaac (elbow) placed on PUP list

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Ravens placed LB Teddye Buchanan on the PUP list.
items.impact: Buchanan is working his way back from a torn ACL he suffered in December. He can be activated at any point during training camp.
items.title: Teddye Buchanan (knee) placed on PUP list

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Ravens placed DL John Jenkins on the PUP list.
items.impact: Jenkins can be activated at any point during training camp.
items.title: John Jenkins placed on PUP list

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Ravens placed DL Travis Jones on the PUP list.
items.impact: Jones can be activated at any point during training camp.
items.title: Travis Jones placed on PUP list

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Ravens waived P Luke Elzinga.
items.impact: Elzinga will figure to seek another opportunity heading into training camp.
items.title: Luke Elzinga waived by Ravens

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Ravens waived OG Jared Penning.
items.impact: Penning will figure to seek another opportunity heading into training camp.
items.title: Jared Penning waived by Ravens

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Ravens placed DT Nnamdi Madubuike on the PUP list.
items.impact: Madubuike missed the last 15 games with a neck injury last season and underwent surgery in April. Ravens officials have expressed optimism in him recently, saying he's headed in the right direction.
items.title: Nnamdi Madubuike (neck) placed on PUP list

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Jets placed DL T'Vondre Sweat on the non-football injury list.
items.impact: Sweat can be activated at any point during training camp.
items.title: T'Vondre Sweat placed on NFI list

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Jets placed EDGE Tyler Baron on the PUP list.
items.impact: Baron finished last season on IR with a knee injury. He can be activated at any point during training camp.
items.title: Tyler Baron (knee) placed on PUP list

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Jets placed WR Tim Patrick on the PUP list.
items.impact: Patrick signed a deal with the Jets back in May. He can be activated at any point during training camp.
items.title: Tim Patrick placed on PUP list

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Bears placed DL Shemar Turner on the PUP list.
items.impact: Turner is working his way back from a torn ACL he suffered last October. He can be activated at any point during training camp.
items.title: Shemar Turner (knee) placed on PUP list

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Bears placed OL Ozzy Trapilo on the PUP list.
items.impact: Trapilo underwent surgery back in January. He can be activated at any point during training camp.
items.title: Ozzy Trapilo placed on PUP list

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Bears placed LB Noah Sewell on the PUP list.
items.impact: Sewell underwent surgery to repair his torn Achilles back in January. His current timetable to return is unclear.
items.title: Noah Sewell (Achilles) placed on PUP list

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Bears placed DB Kyler Gordon on the PUP list.
items.impact: Gordon also missed time during OTAs due to injury. He can be activated at any time during training camp.
items.title: Kyler Gordon placed on PUP list

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Bears placed LB Keyshaun Elliott on the PUP list.
items.impact: Elliott is not able to go to begin training camp for Chicago. He can be activated at any point during camp.
items.title: Keyshaun Elliott placed on PUP list

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Bears placed LB T.J. Edwards on the non-football injury list.
items.impact: Edwards is continuing to work his way back from a broken ankle suffered late last season. He can be activated at any point during training camp.
items.title: T.J. Edwards (ankle) placed on NFI list

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Seahawks are not placing WR Tory Horton on the PUP list.
items.impact: Horton is good to go for training camp after suffering a season-ending shin injury last November. Horton was able to show flashes as a rookie, totaling five receiving touchdowns in seven games prior to his injury. He will be an upside WR4/WR5 for fantasy managers with the Seahawks since bringing in Rashid Shaheed.
items.title: Tory Horton (shin) avoids PUP list
